ns2:course.label: Jewelry Metals VI
ns2:course.description: Continuation of ARTS 430; emphasis on experimentation and development of personal style, a portfolio, and a senior exhibition. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: ARTS 430.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or New Media major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: For Art majors only. Class Materials Fee of $95 required. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
